title: Promotion of A1 + paper-track rebuild
hypothesis: The v42 TREND signal can go live without changing anything else in the book.
question: Can the A1 signal be promoted into the live book with the legacy book still exactly reproducible?
prior: Promotion is an engineering step; the evidence is v42.
method: New signal behind a flag that defaults to legacy; the deployed configuration passes it explicitly.
Parity tests: the legacy flag reproduces the pre-change book bit-for-bit; the new default equals the v42 research copy.
The paper track was rebuilt from inception (2026-06-02) under the new book.
verdict_reason: Deployed; the carry paper track was rebuilt from 2026-06-02. Rebuilt 89 sessions: 2026-06-02 → 2026-10-07 return −1.88% and vol 5.7%, against −1.75% and 6.2% on the old track. The clean forward record for the new book starts with the 2026-10-08 session.
lessons: A change to the book restarts its paper track; the clean forward record begins at the first scheduled run after the rebuild.
